playground.emptyHint: Pick an endpoint and a model below, then type a message or attach images, audio, PDFs or code. Generated HTML, games and animations run right here in the chat.
arena.lineupLocked: locked during the battle — start a new battle to change models
arena.emptyHint: Pick 2–4 models above, then send a message below. Keep chatting: every model continues its own conversation, so you can follow up on each answer.
arena.followUpHint: Your next message continues the battle — each model sees its own previous answers.
runner.hint: Run the HTML/JS you pasted or attached right here — no AI call, no cost
runner.title: Run code
runner.subtitle: runs locally in a sandbox — no AI call, free
hint.label: Tell models they have a browser here
hint.description: Adds a short note to the system prompt: HTML/JS code blocks they write are run live in this app, so “run this code” gets runnable code instead of “I can't run code”.
hint.show: Show the note that is sent
cache.label: Keep session
cache.hint: Keeps chats, battles, settings, game saves and endpoint URLs in this browser across refreshes. The timer restarts on every change.
endpoints.restoredNote: Restored from the session cache — re-enter API keys (they're never saved).
challenge.seedHint: Same seed + difficulty = the exact same puzzle (replayable, shareable).
challenge.confirmAll: Run all {n} challenges against {m} models? That's {r} requests, billed to your keys. The server allows ~10 battles per minute, so the run pauses automatically when needed.
challenge.emptyHint: Every model gets the same generated puzzle; answers are checked automatically in your browser and scored 0–100. Each puzzle starts fresh (no chat history).
errors.http.524: The gateway's proxy (Cloudflare) gave up after ~100 s without a byte — typical for reasoning models that think silently. Fix on the gateway: stream reasoning or send SSE keep-alive comments (": ping" every ~15 s), or bypass the proxy. Or pick a faster/non-thinking model.
errors.http.502: Bad gateway: the gateway couldn't reach the upstream model (down or overloaded). Usually temporary — retry.
errors.http.503: Upstream unavailable / overloaded. Usually temporary — retry later.
errors.http.504: The gateway timed out waiting for the upstream model.
errors.http.400: The gateway rejected the request (often an unsupported parameter or the prompt is too long for this model).
errors.http.404: Model or endpoint not found — check the model id.
errors.http.413: Request too large for this gateway/model.
errors.http.429: Rate limited by the provider/gateway. Slow down or use Sequential.
challenge.maxMovesHint: Cap on the answer's length. ∞ (default) = no limit — see how many moves each model needs.
challenge.untilSolvedHint: If a model's moves don't solve it, it gets the new state and continues — turn after turn — until it's solved (or stuck 3 turns in a row, or a limit is hit).
challenge.maxTurnsHint: Cap on turns per model. ∞ = until solved (Stop anytime). Every turn is billed to your key.
errors.http.530: Cloudflare can't reach the gateway's origin (error 1033 = its Cloudflare Tunnel / cloudflared is down, or the server behind it is offline). Fix it on the gateway server; nothing to change here.
errors.http.520: Cloudflare got an empty/invalid response from the gateway's origin.
errors.http.521: The gateway's origin server refused Cloudflare's connection (server down?).
errors.http.522: Cloudflare timed out connecting to the gateway's origin.
errors.http.523: Cloudflare can't route to the gateway's origin.
errors.http.401: The key was rejected — check it on the Endpoint page.
errors.http.403: Access denied for this key/model (not enabled for your key, or blocked).
board.attemptsThenFinal: {n} attempt(s) while thinking → final answer: {m} moves
board.attemptsHint: The board acted out sequences the model tried in its head; only the final <answer> is scored.
challenge.formatHint: How the cube state is written in the prompt. Pieces: every corner/edge with its colours + what each move does (easier for LLMs). Net: the 6 faces as 3×3 sticker grids.
board.fabricated: Looks made up rather than worked out:
board.fabricatedHint: Heuristic warning only — it doesn't change the score. These patterns are typical of a plausible-looking filler sequence.
challenge.timeLimitHint: Per model. A model still thinking at the limit is cut off (no answer). Reasoning models often need 2–5 min on the cube. Over 15 min also needs the gateway's own stream limit raised (bot-sandroid: Settings → stream request deadline).
errors.truncated: Answer cut off: the provider's output-token limit was reached before the model finished.
errors.truncatedHint: Thinking models spend most of the budget on hidden reasoning. With “Max tokens” on auto the largest budget the provider accepts is already used — this is the provider's (or gateway's) own output cap. A number set in ⚙ Settings overrides auto; clear it to go back to the maximum.
errors.incomplete: Stream cut off: the connection closed before the answer finished (no [DONE], no finish reason).
errors.incompleteHint: Something between the Arena and the model ended it — the gateway/router or the upstream provider (e.g. an injected output-token cap, a proxy, a restart). Check the router log for this request.
challenge.distanceHintHint: Tell the model how many turns the scramble had (so a solution that short exists). Moves stay unlimited — it only tells models what to look for.
board.subtitle: Challenges only: every table is one challenge at one level, so every model took the same kind of test. Free prompts aren't ranked — their difficulty varies too much.
board.ranking: Models with at least “Min runs” results come first. Then ranked by average score (0–100, checked automatically), then solve rate, then average time. Running out of the time limit counts as 0; gateway errors (e.g. 524) don't count. Only standard settings are recorded: one answer per puzzle (not “until solved”), no move cap, default cube format and hint.
board.empty: No results for this challenge at this level yet. Run it in the Arena (Challenges) with “Contribute to leaderboard” on.
